use: Copy `cases` into a westack-eval routing campaign (kind routing) and register it before any description is tuned. The split is fixed here: score the held-out cases once per description version; scoring them against a changed description turns them into dev cases.
population_needed: Names in `expect` must be in the campaign's population: westack-research, westack-debug and westack-plan from this repository, plus the user's own adopt-adapt skill. The user's real population also holds deep-research and search-provider research skills from installed plugins, the likeliest competitors for research requests; keep them in. westack-eval is manual-only, so a request to measure a skill expects NONE from a model-invoked router.
defer_note: Evaluating outside work for adoption into the user's project belongs to the core defer map's research-adopt-adapt entry, not to westack-research: with adopt-adapt in the population those cases expect it; without it, replace it with the fallback above before registering, and say so in the result.
